notes: Adds a river site to NRW's bathing water monitoring and creates a legal driver for upstream improvements on the Tywi; community-led designations are a growing route that may bring further river applications.
summary: On 3 April 2026 Nation.Cymru reported that the Welsh Government had confirmed Bathing Water Designation for the Swing Bridge site on the River Tywi at Llandeilo, after an application by the community group Tywi Bathers. From the 2026 bathing season the site became subject to regular water quality monitoring by NRW and a legal obligation to improve water quality. It is the second river bathing water in Wales, after The Warren on the Wye at Hay-on-Wye in 2024.
title: Llandeilo Swing Bridge on the Tywi designated as Wales' second river bathing water after a community campaign
